scope: Observed multi-GPU transfer defect and single-GPU repair; not a completed return experiment

failed_campaign.disposition: Canceled this owned job after reproducing corrupted inter-GPU copies; all original failures retained
failed_campaign.other_observations: 32B also failed preflight; Mistral freeze started; DeepSeek not started

transfer_probe.inference: Automatic model sharding used the defective copy path; this is a concrete candidate mechanism for the observed first-token failures
transfer_probe.limits: Does not isolate driver, hardware or PyTorch responsibility; does not establish that all RTX systems fail or that historical return differences were caused by this defect

repair.model_placement: The entire model is loaded on allocated CUDA device 0; no automatic sharding or CPU offload
repair.large_model_resources: One scheduler-selected H100 80GB; no node pinning
repair.track_separation: DeepSeek uses separately labeled 8192-token reasoning track; other listed models use 1024-token structured-final track
repair.completion: Not yet observed at publication; access, decoder, decision and accounting gates remain required

validation.execution: CPU-only overlapping step in existing owned allocation
validation.limits: Regression validation is not proof of H100 full-cycle success; fresh real-model qualification still required
